name: pgmq-ts
description: Type-safe PGMQ (Postgres Message Queue) client for Bun. Every operation can join your own transaction.
author: Uchkun Rakhimov

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --format esm && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun run build
